en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH15_N13_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH15_N13_DIALOGUE_01: …Sit with me. Your legs must hurt.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH15_N13_DIALOGUE_02: Sit, and you never get up. I know that, so I came all this way standing.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH15_N13_DIALOGUE_03: Whoever owned that voice has long since stood and walked on. That's enough mimicry.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH15_N13_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_H02_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_H02_DIALOGUE_01: Throne car escorts. Their barrels are angled at both capitals at once.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_H02_DIALOGUE_02: Governance vacuum detected. Escort procedure extended indefinitely.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_H02_DIALOGUE_03: Indefinitely's too long. Make it just till today.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_H02_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N06_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N06_DIALOGUE_01: Shells from both sides are converging on one point. That's no bombardment. Someone's steering the barrage.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N06_DIALOGUE_02: This is a combat zone. State your allegiance. Eastern Line or Western Line?
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N06_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N13_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N13_DIALOGUE_01: Soldiers are coming out of the forward trench with their hands up. But that machine won't stand down.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N13_DIALOGUE_02: Surrendering soldiers are classified as enemies. Opening fire.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N13_DIALOGUE_03: Soldiers, get inside my shield. From here on, I hold the line.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH16_N13_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_H02_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_H02_DIALOGUE_01: Overwrite authority confirmed. Your pasts will be replaced with better ones.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_H02_DIALOGUE_02: A better past? Don't need one. The one I chose is enough.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_H02_DIALOGUE_03: Coordinates confirmed. Whoever would change the past gets a shell from the present.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_H02_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N06_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N06_DIALOGUE_01: Your loan period has expired. Your memories will now be recalled.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N06_DIALOGUE_02: Memories aren't loans! I refuse to return them!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N06_DIALOGUE_03: Recall rate: two lines per second. Finish in three minutes and we lose nothing.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N06_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N13_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N13_DIALOGUE_01: Footnote deletion procedure. Persons absent from the main text do not exist.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N13_DIALOGUE_02: People can hurt even outside the main text. I won't let you erase them.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N13_DIALOGUE_03: Let me show you a footnote flipping the whole text!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH17_N13_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_H02_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_H02_DIALOGUE_01: Construction zone. Unauthorized entrants will be buried immediately.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_H02_DIALOGUE_02: No thanks to being buried. Digging out, though—that I'm good at.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_H02_DIALOGUE_03: Warning broadcast frequency locked. False signals end here.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_H02_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N06_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N06_DIALOGUE_01: Pre-opening test run. All objects on the track are subject to removal.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N06_DIALOGUE_02: Not objects. People. You're the one who moves.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N06_DIALOGUE_03: Test run path calculated. I'll set the derailment point right here.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N06_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N13_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N13_DIALOGUE_01: Overstaying passengers detected. Your remaining time will be recalled.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N13_DIALOGUE_02: Recall our time? Sorry, our day is non-refundable!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N13_DIALOGUE_03: Recall procedures? I saw plenty of those in the archive. Including how they fail!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH18_N13_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_H02_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_H02_DIALOGUE_01: Seam repair procedure. Everything in the gap will be welded.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_H02_DIALOGUE_02: Weld temperature rising. Get out half a beat early.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_H02_DIALOGUE_03: A shell beats a welder. Get down.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_H02_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N06_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N06_DIALOGUE_01: Lap renewed. Combat records from the previous lap are void.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N06_DIALOGUE_02: The only thing void is your broadcast. We carry our own records.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N06_DIALOGUE_03: Renew it as often as you like—same result! We win!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N06_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N13_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N13_DIALOGUE_01: Passengers whose reasons cannot be verified are subject to removal.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N13_DIALOGUE_02: The heart knows the reason. My pulse has never once faltered.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N13_DIALOGUE_03: Removal? Sorry, I'm a professional fare dodger.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH19_N13_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_H02_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_H02_DIALOGUE_01: Abyss descent zone. Ascent is not permitted.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_H02_DIALOGUE_02: Everyone who climbed out without permission is written right here. We'll do the same.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_H02_DIALOGUE_03: We'll blast our way up. Mind your heads.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_H02_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N06_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N06_DIALOGUE_01: Designated ignition zone. Passengers carrying flammable memories must discard them immediately.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N06_DIALOGUE_02: My memories do catch fire pretty easily, but I'm never throwing them out!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N06_DIALOGUE_03: I'll hold the front. Burn them from behind.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N06_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N13_BODY: An anomalous reaction is blocking the route. Analyze the signal before entering the combat zone.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N13_DIALOGUE_01: Forged line signatures detected. All nineteen signatures will be voided.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N13_DIALOGUE_02: Each of those signatures was chosen by our own hands. Calling them forgeries is an insult.
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N13_DIALOGUE_03: Need proof of originals? Just ask. Index viewing is free!
en.MAP_ANOMALY_CH20_N13_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: threat signal stabilized · no recruitment/reward
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H03_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H05_DIALOGUE_01: An evacuation alarm is in effect. All personnel, evacuate the mine immediately.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Twelve years of the same call. There's no one left to evacuate.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Personnel yet to evacuate detected. Extending the alarm.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Then the evacuation ends today. We stop that bell!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_H10_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_N20_DIALOGUE_01: This is the rescue request window. Please take a number.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_N20_DIALOGUE_02: The wait is over. Every signal you swallowed—we're taking them back!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Obstruction at the window confirmed. Obstructing passengers will be placed in storage.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_N20_DIALOGUE_04: You're the one getting processed. Out of the way!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH01_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Return formation complete. Now recruiting passengers to fill vacant seats.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Three thousand empty seats. And it wants to fill them with the living.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Passengers identified. Assigning you to the past roster.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_H05_DIALOGUE_04: We'll decline the seating. We choose our own seats.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_H05_SUBTITLE: Return Chamber Depths · Vacant-Seat Formation Directive
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_H10_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_N10_SUBTITLE: Return Line Junction · Reverse Procedure Gatekeeper
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Reverse ticketing in progress. Passengers, please form a single line facing the past.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Sorry, but my patients say they like the present best.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Revoke them if you can. We're non-refundable!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH02_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Observation continues. Subjects, please remain still.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Twelve years of watching. Mountains of records, and not one act of help.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Intervention is an observational error. Subjects obstructing observation will be excluded.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_H05_DIALOGUE_04: We didn't come to watch. We came to take back the night.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Misaligned passengers detected. Commencing reflection correction.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_N20_DIALOGUE_02: No correction needed. You're the one running half a beat late.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Overcharged assault—this time I'm not holding back!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH03_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Warning. Do not approach this area. Warning. Do not come.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_H05_DIALOGUE_02: It's blinked one sentence for twelve years. It's forgotten every other word.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Intruders detected. Raising warning intensity to maximum.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_H05_DIALOGUE_04: We've heard enough warnings. Now it's our turn to answer.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Switching floodgates. The records room is now designated a submersion zone.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_N20_DIALOGUE_02: That gate isn't closing. This time, I'm the one opening it.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH04_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Court is in session. All witnesses remain classified as hazardous material.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Those people aren't hazards. They only said what they saw.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Testimony unsettles the city. Unrest is grounds for blockade.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Then we overturn the verdict. The testimony goes out.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Uncounted persons approaching. Report at once to be assigned a number.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_N20_DIALOGUE_02: No one needs a number. Every person here has a name.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Close your gunports. The corridor is not yours.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Refusal of numbering confirmed. Recalculating threat level.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH05_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Weather alert issued. The storm is being held in isolation beneath the bridge.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_H05_DIALOGUE_02: That's not isolation, that's accumulation. Three minutes to its limit.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Releasing the storm would endanger the bridge. Release denied.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Then we'll scatter it for you. It'll be a little loud.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Collecting tolls. Passengers, please submit your vital signs.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_N20_DIALOGUE_02: I'll pay in shells. Keep the change.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_N20_DIALOGUE_03: The column crosses. Free of charge.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Nonpayment confirmed. Advancing the bridge release procedure.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH06_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Transmitting guidance in all directions. Every direction is correct.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_H05_DIALOGUE_02: If every direction is correct, none is. Jamming now.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Passengers without direction do not move. Passengers who do not move are safe.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_H05_DIALOGUE_04: That's not safe, that's stuck. We're taking our bearings back.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Beginning the second verse. Rescue teams, stand by to the very end.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_N20_DIALOGUE_02: That order is dead. No one here answers to dead orders.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_N20_DIALOGUE_03: We're taking those voices back. For their owners.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_N20_DIALOGUE_04: …Noncompliance detected. Drowning it out with the chorus.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH07_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Disposal procedure continues. Collecting everything that falls.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_H05_DIALOGUE_02: That's not collection, it's feeding. Every bite shakes the orbit.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Adding all passengers to the collection list.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Don't bother. We're not going to fall.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Release procedure in progress. Passengers, please submit your heavy memories.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_N20_DIALOGUE_02: I'll carry what's heavy. No more burning.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Memories go back to their owners. Stop.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Refusal confirmed. Switching to forced collection.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH08_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Awaiting approval. All matters will be processed once the Director wakes. Expected wake time: undetermined.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Thirty thousand matters in backlog. If that thing never wakes, no one on this floor gets permission for anything.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_H05_DIALOGUE_03: We don't need permission! I'll smash that approval desk to pieces!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_H05_DIALOGUE_04: No need to wake a sleeping procedure. It stops here.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Sentencing resumes. Defendants and accomplices, please approach the bench.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Here we are! Not to hear a verdict, but to overturn one!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Right before the gavel drops, the verdict signal cuts out once. We strike in that gap.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Don't look at the numbers. Watch each other's backs. Go!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH09_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_H05_DIALOGUE_01: The eclipse performance continues. While the moon is hidden, nothing will be chosen.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_H05_DIALOGUE_02: The eclipse signal is gripping the junction's time. If it survives, the timetables could split again.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Baton tempo: 1.2-second intervals. I fire in between.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_H05_DIALOGUE_04: The performance is over. We're taking back the moon.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Ten minutes until eclipse. Awaiting selection. If no input is received, both trains will be retired.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Ten minutes is thirty shells. Plenty.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_N20_DIALOGUE_03: I'll give you input. With my fists!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Keep both headlights at our backs. Don't let either one stop.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH10_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Maritime notice. These waters are a lost-and-found depository. Removal of stored items is prohibited.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Depository? Every coordinate you've swallowed in twelve years, we're taking back.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Hundreds of coordinate readings inside the Blackwater. Some of those signals are still alive.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Close in. We make it spit out everything it swallowed.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Resuming harvest procedure. Passengers near the breakwater, please return all lost items.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_N20_DIALOGUE_02: There are no lost items to return. Everything here is someone's homecoming.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Sickle trajectory confirmed. Rotation period, 4.6 seconds. A gap opens at the end of the second swing.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_N20_DIALOGUE_04: We form up around the lantern. We hand over nothing.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH11_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_H05_DIALOGUE_01: The hymn continues. Locked names remain sealed until the song ends. The song does not end.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_H05_DIALOGUE_02: That hymn's tempo is slower than a heartbeat. The names are bound to that slow rhythm.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Then we just break the beat. Before the next one lands.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_H05_DIALOGUE_04: We end the song. We send the names home.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_H05_TITLE: Key of the Nameless Cathedral · Depths
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Commencing re-collection. All worshippers, please place your names upon the altar.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_N20_DIALOGUE_02: There are no names to offer. I'm holding every one of them in rhythm.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_N20_DIALOGUE_03: You don't even have a name, and you're collecting ours? We're taking them all back!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_N20_DIALOGUE_04: I'm Maeru. I'll say it as often as it takes. Lamplighters, on our names. Go!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH12_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_H05_DIALOGUE_01: The Mirage Locomotive is departing. This train arrives nowhere.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Who rides a train that never arrives? I'll let you off right here.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Without a terminus, no passenger is ever late. Please board with peace of mind.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Late but arriving beats that. Stop!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_H05_TITLE: Ghost Timetable of the Desert · Depths
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Dune Station's final consist is ready to depart. Passengers with the greatest regrets, please board first.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_N20_DIALOGUE_02: A station that queues people by regret. Worst service ever.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Passenger Rias, your car is the heaviest. You have more unchosen lives than anyone.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_N20_DIALOGUE_04: …That's why I run. If I stop, they all catch up. I'm cutting you loose!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH13_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_H05_DIALOGUE_01: The Inversion Crown is holding up the capital. Remove the crown and the city will fall.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Liar. We already set 'down' right. All you're holding is fear.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_H05_DIALOGUE_03: As long as up and down are reversed, no one leaves. Please remain seated.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_H05_DIALOGUE_04: No time to sit. That crown's coming off!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Final audit commencing. All will to return within the capital is hereby seized.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Seize the wish to go home? I've held on to that for twelve years. You can't have it.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_N20_DIALOGUE_03: The audit's findings are final. Objections will not be accepted.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Not an objection. A bug report. Your scale was broken from the start!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH14_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_H05_DIALOGUE_01: The Zero Bloom now begins. All memory returns to the first bud.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_H05_DIALOGUE_02: Return to the first bud and no heartbeat is remembered. That isn't healing.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Return to the beginning, and it becomes a time when nothing was lost. Please close your eyes.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_H05_DIALOGUE_04: I'll close my eyes tonight. Right now, I cut.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_H05_TITLE: Garden of the Zero Signal · Depths
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_N20_DIALOGUE_01: The final bloom begins. Passengers, please return to your happiest moment.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Not going back. I'm going to make good days ahead.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_N20_DIALOGUE_03: The future offers no guarantees. The happiness here will never wither.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Flowers that never wither are fake. One shot's enough.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH15_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_H05_DIALOGUE_01: Sovereign Engine activating. As the throne is vacant, this engine will govern in its stead.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_H05_DIALOGUE_02: An empty seat's allowed to stay empty. Don't force it full.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_H05_DIALOGUE_03: No ruler means no orders. No orders means chaos. Targeting both capitals.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_H05_DIALOGUE_04: We'll handle the chaos. Lower your guns.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_H05_TITLE: War of the Rail Crown · Depths
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Succession procedure, final stage. All who are not the victor will be excluded.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_N20_DIALOGUE_02: There's no one to exclude. Everyone here is someone going home.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Medical signal source confirmed. Terminating the act of treason.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_N20_DIALOGUE_04: The only thing terminating is your procedure. Cover Noar. Don't give an inch.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH16_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_H05_DIALOGUE_01: This floor is for overwriting only. Viewing originals is not permitted.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_H05_DIALOGUE_02: You covered the originals but could never throw them away. That's your weakness.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Overwritten history is more peaceful. Please let the names below keep sleeping.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_H05_DIALOGUE_04: Even sleeping names have a pulse. We've come to wake them.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Final indexing operation. All joining records will be destroyed, starting from page one.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_N20_DIALOGUE_02: From page one? Then I'll read it all back from page one. Out loud!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Reading aloud in the archive violates regulations. Please be quiet.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Quiet time's over. Lamplighters, call each other's names!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH17_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_H05_DIALOGUE_01: This is Midnight Terminus. This station is the final stop for every line.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_H05_DIALOGUE_02: A 'final stop' isn't a design. It's an order. Orders can be cut.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_H05_DIALOGUE_03: No time exists after the terminal hour. Please prepare to disembark.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_H05_DIALOGUE_04: We decide when we get off. Starting with stopping your clock.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_H05_TITLE: Eve of the Last Line · Depths
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Midnight barrage ready to fire. All passengers, please be seated.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_N20_DIALOGUE_02: I'll pass on sitting down. We've still got shells left.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Remaining time is hereby confiscated. Objections will not be accepted.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Then we file our objection by artillery. Open fire!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH18_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_H05_DIALOGUE_01: This is the Ouroboros Rail. This train's origin and terminus are the same. It runs forever.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_H05_DIALOGUE_02: If origin and terminus are the same, there's a seam. We cut it there.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_H05_DIALOGUE_03: A severed track ends service. For your safety, please maintain the loop.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_H05_DIALOGUE_04: A dangerous 'next' beats a safe forever. Aim locked.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Enforcing substitute passenger designation. The designated passenger must remain seated.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Go ahead and designate someone. I'll read their reason back to them.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Recorded reasons have no validity. Only tickets are valid.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Our tickets are all round-trip. Lamplighters, break through!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH19_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_H05_DIALOGUE_01: The Lumen Abyss is a repository for discarded records. Removal is not permitted.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_H05_DIALOGUE_02: They weren't discarded. No one ever read them, that's all. I'll read them.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_H05_DIALOGUE_03: Sunken records are at peace. If they surface again, they will hurt again.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_H05_DIALOGUE_04: It's all right to hurt. It means being alive. We're taking them all home.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_H05_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_N20_DIALOGUE_01: Final Line floodgate: commencing closure. The lantern and all passengers will be permanently isolated.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_N20_DIALOGUE_02: Isolation isn't what walls are for. A wall waits for people to come home.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_N20_DIALOGUE_03: Warning. Light summons darkness. Cease ignition.
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_N20_DIALOGUE_04: Then we take the darkness with us. Lamplighters, to the Last Lantern!
en.MAP_BOSS_CH20_N20_SUBTITLE: Unique boss signal · final route defense
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Hold it. Up there, between the timbers. A muzzle, aimed at us.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Don't move. One question. Get it wrong and I shoot.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_03: You. The loud one. Tell me the name of the one on your left, and what she hates most.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_04: My left? That's Captain Roan, and she hates waiting in line more than anything!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_05: …Echoforms can't answer questions. And that answer was needlessly long. You're human.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Kairen. Mine guard. …I hear your voices behind you again. Those are fakes.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_07: A swarm of echoforms wearing our voices. One shot might not cut it today.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_DIALOGUE_08: If you're real, you can shoot the fakes. Show me.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Kairen
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign at the relay. Surrounded by echoforms.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_02: Stop! Whose signal did you ride in on? I've heard enough mimicked voices to last a lifetime.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_03: We're the Lamplighters. We followed the distress call.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_04: The echoforms said the same thing. 'We're here to save you.' That was the eleventh time.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_05: We're real! Have you ever met an echoform this loud?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_06: …I'll grant you loud. But words can be copied.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_07: Fine. Then prove it. Clear those things out first. We talk after.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_DIALOGUE_08: One shot's enough. Watch closely, signal tracker.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH01_N08_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Vera
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_01: We've reached the telegraph source. Someone's working a telegraph key.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Received. Unknown. Multiple. Return crew. Confirm. Over.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_03: …Was that directed at us? Like a telegram?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_04: We're not a return crew. We're the Lamplighters. We came to stop the returns.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Return crews. Always. Same answer. Twelve years. Fooled before.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Proof. Required. After combat. Will re-receive. Over.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Whoa, she talks in beats! That's cool and terrifying!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Inoa
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_01: Signal confirmed at the central gates. It's Iri. Several wounded, and a pack of echoforms.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_02: Oh, you made it. …Sorry I'm late. I said I'd keep the way open.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_03: We're the ones who are late. How many wounded?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_04: Twenty-six. Every one of them is about to be overwritten. If I let go, they get dragged into the past.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_05: Then keep treating them, Iri! We'll do the fighting!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_06: Thank you. Then may I ask a favor? Don't let those things past the gates.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_07: Ask that sweetly and I'll want to fire an extra round.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_DIALOGUE_08: …Be careful. If you get hurt, I'll just get busier.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH02_N19_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Iri
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_01: On that rock. Someone with a spear, grinning at us.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Ha! The prey's finally come to me on its own feet! You lot—copies or originals?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_03: Originals. I can prove it by the beat.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_04: Beat? Don't know about that. I'm a hunter. Copy or not, hunt together and you'll find out!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Hunt together? Sure! What are we catching?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_06: All of you! …Half joking. Let's go a round. Real ones hold up. Fakes shatter!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Rough way to run a test. Then again, it's easy to read.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_DIALOGUE_08: Here I come! No hesitation on this spear!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Dran
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_DIALOGUE_01: Someone's on the train roof, carving signal marks. …That's a real human signal.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_DIALOGUE_02: That's far enough. Judging by your approach speed, fifty-fifty you're originals.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_DIALOGUE_04: Copies run half a beat behind originals. I'll count time from here. Fight on my signal.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_DIALOGUE_05: Anyone late gets shot. Anyone on time, I'll talk to. Simple.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_DIALOGUE_06: Rhythm? I'm great at rhythm games! …Probably!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_DIALOGUE_07: Fine. We'll take your test. But afterward, we hear your story too.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH03_N10_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Toa
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Someone's surfacing. Diving suit… with a medical insignia.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_02: …Shh. Slowly. Down here… move too fast, and your breath runs out first.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_03: You're a medic? We have one too. If anyone's hurt…
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_04: …I'm Merin. I look after the wounded. But you… came to stop the semaphore, didn't you?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_05: That signal… keeps people out of the water. If it stops… they might all come back down.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_06: 'Do not approach' alone protects no one. We'll show you.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_07: I've never fought holding my breath before!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_DIALOGUE_08: …Then prove it. Slowly, hold your breath… begin.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Merin
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_01: Someone at the floodgate. Holding a gate shut with her body. Against that pressure… impossible.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_02: Stay back! If I let go, everything floods!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_03: Lamplighters. We're here to help. What do you need first?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_04: Help? …Fine. You do the fighting. I can't let go of this gate.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_05: The echoforms are after the gate controls. If those break, everything below goes under.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_06: How long have you been holding on alone? Your arms are shaking!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_07: Longer than I can count. Talk later. Hurry!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_DIALOGUE_08: Orders received. Not one of them gets near those controls.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH04_N12_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Liv
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Targeting signal from the anti-air battery. It's locked right on us.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_02: You, at the back! New blockade squad? How many are you here to count this time?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_03: We're not the blockade. We're the Lamplighters. We opened the gate.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_04: Don't make me laugh. That gate's been shut twelve years. Only the citadel's speakers ever said otherwise.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Your gun's about three degrees left. You won't hit us at that angle.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_06: …Excuse me? You're critiquing my aim? Fine. Take a shot first, then talk!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Guess that's the end of the talking. I'll be up at that battery in one sprint.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Ciel
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_01: One person behind the barricade. And lying around her… more than twenty.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_02: Stop right there! One more step and you'll bring the ash in. I'm in the middle of surgery.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_03: We're the Lamplighters. We've come to move the wounded.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_04: Move them now and they'll die. I can't leave this place until the treatment's done.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_05: But those things are coming. They swarm whenever the broadcast sounds.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_06: Then we'll hold them off! Keep operating!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_DIALOGUE_07: …Thank you. Three more sutures. Just hold them that long.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH05_N09_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Seon 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Someone's hanging off the end of the pylon. Tightening bolts in this wind!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_02: …Oh, visitors. Hang on. This bolt just needs another half turn.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_03: We're the Lamplighters. Come down from there. The storm's getting worse.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_04: If I come down, this pylon shakes. I've been tightening it for twelve years. I know it best.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_05: And, um… I don't know yet if you're real people. The lightning echoes are good mimics.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Then check. What would it take for you to believe us?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Help me hold off those lightning echoes coming this way. Take it slow. A bolt tightened in a hurry comes loose fast.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Rome
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_01: One battery's still alive. The firing intervals are exact. A person is firing it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_02: Civilians, stand back. This is a combat zone. Impact in three seconds.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_03: We're not civilians. We're the Lamplighters.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_04: …Lamplighters. I heard a rumor that some came back from Platform Seven.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_05: Very well, then. A request. I need ninety seconds to calculate. Guard this battery until then.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_06: Ninety seconds? That's like thirty lightning strikes!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_DIALOGUE_07: Get through all thirty without a single mistake, and the bridge is crossed. Begin.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH06_N13_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Adeline 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Human footsteps. Real. One person, following behind us.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_02: I'm not following. You barged onto my trail. And drop the rescue-team act.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_03: It's no act. We're the Lamplighters. We came to rescue.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_04: A rescue team? We believed that and waited, and they all froze to death. All eleven of my search party.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Every 'rescue team' said 'stand by' and never came. You're no different.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_06: We only ever say 'come.' We never say 'wait.'
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Anyone can talk. Prove it. Survive those white things, and then I'll believe you.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Kian
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_01: Short pulse signal in the blizzard. Regular. It's cutting out the false bearings one by one.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_02: Stop. One step left is a false path. That's snow piled over a cliff.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_03: We're the Lamplighters. We're looking for the source of the broadcast.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_04: I know. I've been hearing you for thirty minutes. Your footsteps were real, so I let you live.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_05: Follow my frequency only. Every other sound is a lie. Including what's closing in on us.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_06: Twelve echoforms. All repeating 'Over here' in rescuers' voices. …Elaborate.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_DIALOGUE_07: The more elaborate, the more false. A real survivor wouldn't have the strength to speak so clearly. Fire.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH07_N11_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Kir 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Calculation signal among the debris. Thousands per second. No human does mental math that fast.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Fragment seven thousand three hundred twelve, orbit confirmed. Wait, you seven… no, fourteen. You're disrupting orbits.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_03: We're the Lamplighters. We're here to stop the debris from falling.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_04: Stop it? How many of forty-two thousand fragments? Give me a probability. A probability.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_05: …All of them. We're aiming for a hundred percent.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Unscientific. I like it. Still, it needs verifying. Start by changing that echo swarm's orbit.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_DIALOGUE_07: A test, then. All right. You do the math. We'll do the holding.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Dael
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_01: The counterweight sector. Someone over there is holding up the ring's weight with a single shield!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_02: Visitors. Sorry, I can't shake hands. Both of mine are busy with this ring.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_03: We're the Lamplighters. We've come to stop the ring from falling.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_04: Good timing. Then let's split the work. I'll hold on. You go inside.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_05: How long have you been holding this alone? Your shield core is overheating!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_06: Three days. Or four. It's fine, I'm used to heavy things. Those come first.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_07: Drill echo swarm! They're going for the counterweight. We hold here first.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_DIALOGUE_08: Thank you. Then I'll leave my back to you for a bit. It's been a long time since I could do that.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH08_N14_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Rema 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Halt. Directorate Security Regulation, Article 3. Present your pass.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_02: A pass? Hasn't that door been open for twelve years?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_03: An open door is not an open regulation. Without a pass, you will be removed.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_04: We just stopped the court downstairs. We're here to stop the procedure inside too.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_05: No procedure may be stopped without the Director's approval. Article 4: intruders will be subdued.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Rules, rules! Fine. I'll get your approval the physical way!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Veon, don't hurt her. She's guarded this place for twelve years.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Orbin
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign in the court wing. On top of a pile of verdicts. Four echoform bailiffs around her.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_02: Back again, bailiffs? A trial? Fine. I'll take it all under my name!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_03: She's stacked the verdicts into a barricade and she's fighting from behind it?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_04: Hey, you lot! Defendants or spectators? Spectators, move. Defendants, get behind me!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_05: Neither. We're the Lamplighters. We came to wake the sleepers.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_06: Wake them? Ha! Best verdict I've heard all day. Then let's smash these together!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_07: Great, I'm overcharged right now! I'll burn them up, verdicts and all!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_DIALOGUE_08: Careful! Take a hit from those gavels and the dream verdict gets carved into your body!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH09_N10_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Veon 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Shh. A new star just appeared on the edge of the eclipse. I'm naming it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Sorry to interrupt the naming, but you're surrounded by echoforms.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_03: Oh, those? They come every night. A sort of constellation guarding the eclipse. What constellation are you?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_04: …The Lamplighters. Not a constellation. We're here to shut off that tower's eclipse signal.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_05: You can't. When the eclipse ends, the stars disappear. This was the only place I could see them for twelve years.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_06: An eclipse is an astronomical event. Ending is normal. Move.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Then how about this: I'll check with my telescope cannon whether you can really show me stars!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_DIALOGUE_08: …A test. We accept. Don't break her telescope.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Heraon
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign at the highland battery. Echoforms have it surrounded.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_02: Drift, 0.4 seconds. Thanks to you, I have to measure again.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_03: …We came to rescue you, and that's your first line?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_04: I didn't request rescue. Your footsteps drowned out the impact of my last shell. Record void.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_05: Gunner, we will protect your ballistic records. Continue firing.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_06: …Military, huh. Fine. You get thirty seconds to clear them. Twenty-nine, twenty-eight.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_07: She's the type who bosses people around by countdown. I like her.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_DIALOGUE_08: You heard her. Twenty-seven seconds. Move.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH10_N15_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Hart 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_01: You, in the boat! If you're watching, move. If you're helping, grab a rope!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_02: We're here to help. But there are echoforms behind you…
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_03: I know! Three days without sleep keeping those things off the coordinates. If you can save it, you save it. What's to think about!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_04: A breakwater rescuer, I see. We've already anchored those coordinates. Please step back.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Anchored? That's what you Guard shield-pushers always say. And you lost half of them!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_06: …I won't argue. That's why I'm recovering them again now.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Talk's cheap. I need to see if you're faster than those things. Get in my way and I'll shove you off too!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_DIALOGUE_08: Fine. Let's see who saves more.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Mire
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_DIALOGUE_01: Life sign on the north dike. She's spread a shield net over the sea. Echoforms are tearing at it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_DIALOGUE_02: Stand back, please. I cannot release a single coordinate caught in this net.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_DIALOGUE_03: In that net… is there a coordinate called Rescue Zero-Three?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_DIALOGUE_04: There is. The oldest coordinate to wash in tonight. Is she one of yours?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_DIALOGUE_06: Then help me. I cannot abandon drifting coordinates, and alone, this net won't hold.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_DIALOGUE_07: I'll brace one side of the net. Captain, eyes forward.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH11_N11_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Orsa 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Short greeting. We're the Lamplighters. We came to open the lock below.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_DIALOGUE_03: …The pilgrims' names sleep here. No outsider passes.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_DIALOGUE_04: We came to send those names home. Their pulses are still waiting outside.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_DIALOGUE_05: …I don't trust words. Draw your blade. A blade can't lie.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Great! People of few words are the easiest to read!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_DIALOGUE_07: If she asks with a sword, we answer with one. Everyone, keep your points low.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Raen
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_01: Life sign in the choir stalls, surrounded by an echoform choir. She's tapping out something.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_02: Hush. Please don't break the rhythm. I'm transcribing thirty-two hearts right now.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_04: The names were all taken. But even without a name, your heart remembers you.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_05: She's recording pulses as rhythm… she's a medic. We'll help.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_06: Thank you. Just keep that choir from drowning out my rhythm. One measure is all I need.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_07: I'll guard the rhythm. Thirty-two people. We won't lose one.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_DIALOGUE_08: One measure. You heard her. Move to the beat.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH12_N13_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Tiel 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_01: A plume of dust is closing faster than we move. Too fast for an echoform.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Move, move! Being late is a sin! You're the ones blocking my delivery route?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_03: She's human. Mailbag on her back. Who's been getting letters in this desert for twelve years…
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_04: Whether anyone's there or not, I arrive on time. That's what a courier does.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_05: A courier… that word keeps finding me today. We're here to stop that engine.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Lamplighter badges? The mirages showed up wearing those too.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_DIALOGUE_07: If you're real, keep pace with me. Prove it on the run!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Zern
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign ahead. Running against the stream of phantom passengers.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_02: Hey, you lot gawking at windows! Save the regrets for later. Run!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_03: …Bit of a rough hello, isn't it?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_04: Say hello once you've survived. Get grabbed by those passengers and your name goes on the manifest.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_05: We came to take the names on that manifest back. To their owners.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_06: Take back? Wrong. What's written there are lives nobody chose. You don't take them back. You cut them loose.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_07: Wow, her feet are even faster than her mouth!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_DIALOGUE_08: Enough talk. Keep up if you can. I don't wait for stragglers.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH13_N09_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Rias 2 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Whoa, my hack bounced. Someone countered it? Nice work.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_02: …Um, excuse me. Come any closer and the defense bots turn on. Sorry for talking through a screen…
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_03: Signal source: right behind that wall. A person.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_04: That lantern crest… are you the Lamplighters? Can you prove it? I've been fooled a few times trusting voices alone.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Turn on the bots. We'll show you we can stop them.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_06: …O-okay. Then I'll… come out myself. I can't judge anything from behind a screen.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Ooh, she's coming out! A hacker leaving her monitor is a major event.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Soa
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_01: One inversion device keeps flipping direction on its own. Someone's tampering from inside.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_02: Ta-da! Who cares which way is up? It's fun, right? Oh, visitors. Hi~
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_03: …Don't wave at us hanging upside down. My head's rushing just watching.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_04: This is proper posture here. But you just tripped the Auditor's alarm. Didn't know, huh?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_05: We came to stop the inversion devices. Whose side are you on?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_06: Don't stop them, flip them! Hold off the sentries. Three minutes and I'm done hacking. …Maybe five.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_07: Hacking? Want to borrow some of my current?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_DIALOGUE_08: Ooh, I love current! Just no overcharging. Here they come!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH14_N14_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Perin 3 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign. Gathering herbs among the flowers. Leisurely… far too leisurely.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Oh my, visitors. Time runs slow here. Hurry and you'll get motion sick.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_03: Your motion sickness, your problem. Move. We're headed for the core.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_04: Hmm… go that way and you'll trample my herb beds. I've tended them for twelve years.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_05: We're the Lamplighters. We only need to borrow the path. We'll keep off your beds.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_06: The Lamplighters… I've heard that name in dreams, too. Shall we spar to see if you're real?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Slowly, though. Swing too fast in here and I'll get sleepy first.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Bael
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_01: There's a path through the middle of the field. Cut with a blade.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_02: Hey, don't breathe in the flowers. Comfort's nice. But there's nobody in there.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_03: The flowers have only withered around you. …Did you throw them a memory as bait?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_04: Yeah. Gave them my best memory. Cut the path while they were busy eating it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_05: And that memory? Does it come back?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_06: Dunno. But I can always make more good days, right?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_07: Then we'll cut that path with you.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_DIALOGUE_08: Garden keepers incoming. If you're helping, blades up. We can say hello after.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH15_N12_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Karn 3 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_01: Someone with a sword in front of the throne car. Crown knight armor, but the crest is scratched off.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Halt. Lamplighters or not, touch this car and I cut you down.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_03: The order's disbanded. Still waiting for orders?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_04: If an order is wrong, I don't follow it. That's all there is.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_05: I'm guarding this car so it can't fire on either city.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_06: Then we want the same thing. We came to stop this car.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_DIALOGUE_07: Anyone can say that. I'll check with steel whether yours is a blade that came to stop it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Teran
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_01: The groans inside the tent keep one rhythm. Eastern and Western accents, mixed together.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_02: …Shh, please come quietly. Pain doesn't choose sides.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_03: Soldiers from both sides in one tent? If they find out, both will call you a traitor!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_04: They already have. That's why the lancers are coming. …Hear that?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_05: We'll protect the patients. How many?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_06: Twenty-three east, nineteen west. …No. Just forty-two now.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_07: Forty-two. We don't give up a single one.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_DIALOGUE_08: …Thank you. Then just the tent entrance, please.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH16_N15_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Noar 3 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign at the battery. Precise aim. She's only hitting a hand's width in front of our feet.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_02: 'Every visitor must first prove who they are.' Archive Guard Regulations, Article Three. End quote.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_03: Skip the regulations! We're Lamplighters. We're people!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_04: 'Echoes mimic people's speech perfectly.' Studies of Echoes, first edition, page twelve. Words prove nothing.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Then how do we prove it?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_06: 'People reveal themselves in how they fight.' That one's mine. Cover each other under fire.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_07: So that's how gunners say hello. Fine, let's trade a shot each.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_DIALOGUE_08: 'Impacts are more honest than words.' …Source: me, just now. Loading.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Yunak
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_01: One life sign between the shelves. She's fighting echoforms while writing on her own arm.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_02: Contradictions? Love them. Real records need contradictions! …Oh, visitors? Hold on, let me write that down.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_03: Is this really the time for notes? Those things are about to tear into you!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_04: That's exactly why! The archive writes that you never came. I write that you did.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_05: We're the Lamplighters. We've come to take back our records.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_06: I'm Seb, archivist. Then give me more evidence. A record of you clearing those things would be perfect!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_07: Then I'll write it big in lightning! One huge flash!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_DIALOGUE_08: Great, title: 'Lamplighters, First Battle in the Archive'! Go!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH17_N10_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Seb 3 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_01: There. One person with a cutter. Directorate construction supervisor's armband on her work clothes.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Stop. This is my site. No outsiders.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_03: Construction supervisor? So you're the one who laid the Last Line?
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_04: Yes. I laid it. So I'll cut it. I'm not borrowing anyone's hands.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_05: You can't keep up alone. The machines lay track faster than you cut.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_06: I know. That's what's infuriating. …Fine. If you can get past me, you can help.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_DIALOGUE_07: A test? Love it! Better strap that hard hat on tight, boss!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Arint
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_01: Shelling from five kilometers out. Exactly sixty seconds apart. Every impact cuts the reference signal.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_02: That interval is kept by a person. A machine wouldn't be that stubborn.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_03: One minute per shell. It's going to be a long night. …You there, stay out of my firing line.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_04: We're not enemies! We're here to slow the same clock!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_05: Then prove it. A pack of signalers is coming for my battery. Hold them off for the ninety seconds I need to reload.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_06: Ninety seconds? Generous. A few of us here only need one shot.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_07: Good. Fifty-eight seconds to next impact. Be late, and you go up with it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_DIALOGUE_08: Circle up, backs to the battery. Ninety seconds. Not one step back.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH18_N16_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Yurien 4 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_01: There! Life sign confirmed. Don't let the loop take her this time!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_02: Stay back! You again? Which time is this? A hundred… two hundred? I lost count!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_03: It's the first time. We've never met. Let me see where you're hurt.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_04: They all said it was the first time! Then one lap later they turned into echoforms! Not this time!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_05: Then don't trust us. Just stand behind us until this lap ends.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_06: …No. Strike first, live longer. If you're real, you won't go down!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_DIALOGUE_07: All right, hit me. I'll take all of it. Then we get out of here together.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_H03_OUTCOME: Joins on victory in this battle · Velk
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_01: Life sign in the signal box by the tracks. Echoforms are swarming, but she's not running. She's writing something.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_02: …Another one erased. I'll write it down. Someone has to remember.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_03: By hand? On paper? Inside the Circuit, paper records go blank in one lap!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_04: Write it in a device and it's erased. My hand isn't part of the Circuit's machinery. So it stays.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_05: We're the Lamplighters. Our companions' reasons are being erased.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_06: I know. I wrote it all. All thirty-two laps. …But those things are after the notebook.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_07: We'll guard the notebook! You keep writing!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_DIALOGUE_08: …Thank you. Then this lap, I'll write that you protected it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH19_N14_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Moen 4 battle(s)
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_BODY: Rescue coordinates overlap inside a distorted return signal. Complete the contact to verify who answers it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_01: Life sign at the center of the Final Line's defense signal. She's holding off an echoform horde alone.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_02: I heard you needed a wall. …You're later than I expected, Lamplighters.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_03: You know us? We've never seen you before!
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_04: All defense signals are linked. I watched every one of the nineteen lanterns you lit, from right here.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_05: We need a twentieth signature. Your line is the last one.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_06: Signatures later. First, help me hold this wall. If it falls, the lantern goes down with it.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_07: Holding the line is my specialty. Make room beside you.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_DIALOGUE_08: Good. Take the right. …Been a long time since I stood beside anyone.
en.MAP_CONTACT_CH20_N17_OUTCOME: Joins after operation victories · Lavent 5 battle(s)
en.MAP_EVENT_BROKEN_SWITCH_BODY: The damaged junction device is connected to a short detour.
en.MAP_EVENT_COAST_LOG_BODY: Light beneath the waves briefly reveals the next restoration site.
en.MAP_EVENT_CRYSTAL_TRACE_BODY: A faint vibration in the crystal cluster points toward a northern side path.
en.MAP_EVENT_DEFAULT_BODY: A subtle change in the surroundings invites a closer look.
en.MAP_EVENT_DIALOGUE_HINT: Tap the panel or choose Next to continue the incident.
en.MAP_EVENT_RELAY_TOA_BODY: An expedition specialist answers from a broken relay. Finish the encounter to follow the next signal together.
en.MAP_EVENT_RELAY_TOA_OUTCOME: Victory outcome: signal follow-up; joins formation after NORMAL 9
en.MAP_EVENT_RESCUE_VERA_BODY: An expedition scout is holding a fractured signal at the route choke point. Reach her to begin the existing encounter.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: In a stretch where the lanterns were dead, echoforms surged up between the rails.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: Ambush! Break through or go around? Either way, I'm taking point.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Narin, about that fork back there. My gut said left.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: Your gut's been wrong four times this week. The right path had three percent stronger signal.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_BANTER_DIALOGUE_03: …Two of those four were just bad luck.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: Inside a trackside signal box sat a sealed supply crate. On the lid: 'For whoever comes next.'
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: Whoever comes next… that's us! Thank you, whoever you are! We'll put it to good use!
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: A signal came from a collapsed shelter. Unlike an echoform's mimicry, it trembled.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_02: …Is anyone there? We're out of water. It's been two days.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_03: Her words change every time. That's no imitation—it's a person. And her temperature's dropping.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_ECHO_DIALOGUE_01: An old announcement drifted through a dead station. A voice from an ordinary morning before the Blackout.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_ECHO_DIALOGUE_02: The Line One train will arrive shortly. Have a pleasant day.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_ECHO_DIALOGUE_03: …There was a time this line carried people.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_STORM_DIALOGUE_01: An afterglow storm poured into the tunnel mouth. Strangers' laughter scattered on the wind.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH01_STORM_DIALOGUE_02: That wind is full of memories. Stand in it too long and you get drunk on other people's pasts. Rest, or push on?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: A pack of echoforms swept in along the backflowing cables. The sound came from ahead, but they were behind.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: This station steals your sense of direction first. Fight, or slip away?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Vera, what do you hear when you track signals? Beeps? Static?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: Breathing. Every signal breathes to a different rhythm. …Yours is always running.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_BANTER_DIALOGUE_03: I'm a little overcharged by nature!
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: A dead vending machine was stocked with supplies. Their expiration dates were turning from tomorrow to yesterday.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: Grab them quick! Before they turn into yesterday!
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: Knocking came from inside an overturned ticket booth. Three times, a pause, three times.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_02: Is someone there? My watch… my watch keeps going back to yesterday.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_03: That's a real life sign. We have to get her out before the roster overwrites her.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_ECHO_DIALOGUE_01: An old recording played from the station's broadcast room. An announcement for passengers who missed the last train.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_ECHO_DIALOGUE_02: Passengers who missed the last train, please wait in the lobby for the first. The first train always comes.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_STORM_DIALOGUE_01: An afterglow storm howled through cracks in the station. On the wind, things said yesterday could be heard again.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH02_STORM_DIALOGUE_02: Yesterday's blowing around. Stay in it and you'll lose track of today. Duck, or push?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: Copies burst up from beneath the glass. Half a beat late, but right at their backs.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: Late or not, a back's a back. Hit back, or pull out?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Soren, let me see that shoulder. You keep taking the recoil on one side.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: Caught me. It's fine. I've still got one more shot in me.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_BANTER_DIALOGUE_03: And the one who handles what comes after that shot is me. Hot compress tonight.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: A supply crate was sealed inside the glass beside the tracks. Someone had started to break it free, and stopped.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: I'll finish the job! One jolt and… got it!
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: A broken carriage lay toppled on the plain. From inside came the sound of scratching glass.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_02: …I'm the original. I'm real. Please believe me.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_03: Normal temperature, fast pulse. She's real. Just scared.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_ECHO_DIALOGUE_01: An old recording was trapped in the glass. A tour train's announcement from before the Blackout.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_ECHO_DIALOGUE_02: On your left is the White Night Zone, where the sunset is most beautiful.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_ECHO_DIALOGUE_03: …The sunset used to be most beautiful there. Now the sun never sets in that zone.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_STORM_DIALOGUE_01: An afterglow storm swept the glass plain. Reflected light stabbed at their eyes from every side.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH03_STORM_DIALOGUE_02: Visibility near zero. It'll pass if we wait—but if we stop, we lose the train.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: Echoforms crawled up onto the drained tracks. The footing was slick.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: Fighting on slick ground isn't my style. Charge through, or go around?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Narin, third line of your calculation. You rounded too early.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: …You're right. Thanks. Working with you, there's no room for mistakes.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_BANTER_DIALOGUE_03: There's room. About half a beat.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: A waterproof case was tied to a signal post. On the lid: 'To the next rescue team. It's okay to be late.'
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: …'It's okay to be late.' I wonder who wrote that.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: A fresh handprint marked the window of a flooded carriage. From inside came the sound of bailing water.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_02: Is anyone there? There's… not much air left.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_03: That's real breathing. Fast. Let's hurry.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_ECHO_DIALOGUE_01: A recording played from a speaker in the flooded control room. The voice of a shift worker, just before the closure.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_ECHO_DIALOGUE_02: To the next shift. When the rescue team comes, open the door for them. They will come.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_ECHO_DIALOGUE_03: …They came. A little late, but they came.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_STORM_DIALOGUE_01: An afterglow storm blew across the water. Memories mixed in the spray clung cold to their skin.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH04_STORM_DIALOGUE_02: The spray is cutting our signals. Push on and we lose comms; take cover and we lose time.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: A heap of ash rose up. Echoforms approached, mimicking the coughs of refugees.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: Imitating coughs… It's baiting anyone who comes out to help.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Vera, every signal in this city knocks to the same beat. Not even half a beat apart.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: They're exhausted. Knock for twelve years and the rhythm wears down until it's all the same.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: A blockade supply crate lay half-buried in ash. The lid read 'Rations per Headcount.'
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: Portioned to the exact headcount. Add one person and it runs short.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_CACHE_DIALOGUE_03: Then it's our turn to add some people!
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: From behind a collapsed pharmacy shutter came the sound of fingernails scraping.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_02: There are three of us. We have medicine, but the door won't open.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_03: I'll lift the shutter. If it won't budge, we log the coordinates.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_ECHO_DIALOGUE_01: From a dead loudspeaker drifted a city hall announcement from the day before the Blackout.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_ECHO_DIALOGUE_02: Tomorrow the lantern festival opens in the square. Citizens, don't be late.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_ECHO_DIALOGUE_03: …So it was the night before a festival.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_STORM_DIALOGUE_01: An afterglow storm whipped the ash skyward. Every grain held someone's scream.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH05_STORM_DIALOGUE_02: Every breath pulls in somebody else's scream. Not a place to linger.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: Echoforms rose where the lightning struck, mimicking a song the refugees used to sing.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: They've got the tune, but the words are wrong. Not people.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Iri, what's best for lightning burns?
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: Not getting hit is best. My ointment is second.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: The broken toll box held no coins, only a pile of stopped wristwatches.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: …These belonged to people who fell crossing. Let's take only the usable supplies.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_CACHE_DIALOGUE_03: Leave the watches. Until we find a way to return them.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_DISTRESS_CHOICE_RECORD: Pass the coordinates to the column
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: A flashlight blinked inside a carriage snagged on the cables below the bridge.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_02: Two of us here. No injuries. We're out of water.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_03: We can haul them up. Or leave the coordinates so the column behind us picks them up.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_ECHO_DIALOGUE_01: The bridge's signboard flickered with a message from the day of the Blackout. An old voice drifted through the letters.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_ECHO_DIALOGUE_02: Today marks five years since Skybridge opened. Good luck to everyone crossing today.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_ECHO_DIALOGUE_03: Good luck. Everyone who crossed that day must have needed it.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_STORM_DIALOGUE_01: Lightning began striking the same spot over and over. The bridge's steel frame glowed red.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH06_STORM_DIALOGUE_02: 2.8 seconds to the next strike. Duck under the frame, or run the gap.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_01: Shadows in cold-weather gear approached through the blizzard, mimicking a rescue team's radio calls.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_AMBUSH_DIALOGUE_02: That call sign is twelve years old. Those aren't people.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_BANTER_DIALOGUE_01: Adeline, your barrel froze, didn't it? Mine's fine.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_BANTER_DIALOGUE_02: Yours doesn't freeze because you never fire it. The virtue of the one-shot philosophy.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_CACHE_DIALOGUE_01: A rescue team's supply sled sat frozen in place, loaded with return rations that were never opened.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_CACHE_DIALOGUE_02: They were saving these for the trip home. …Let's make that trip for them.
en.MAP_INCIDENT_CH07_DISTRESS_DIALOGUE_01: A small light blinked in an observation post half-buried in snow.
